card.name: Dots inside web addresses
card.fires_on: The period or domain piece right after a site name in a web address, especially the ".e" after "www". It also fires on ".org", ".com" and similar endings in names like Torah.org or Freerice.com.

modes.label: Dot after www
modes.description: The ".e" piece right after "http://www" at the start of a web address, often in a citation or link.

modes.label: Domain ending after a site name
modes.description: A ".org", ".com" or ".blogspot" piece directly after a site name in running text.
